title: The Tower
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the report of anomaly Alice

I suppose I should start at the beginning.

Evan Glass is dead.

Mayor Marigold died mere days before the anniversary of Castle Fall. Before his death, Evan Glass sent the Mayor a message warning him of what was coming. Unfortunately, it was too late.

On the eve of the anniversary, the **Sandwalker effect** began to emerge. A temporal anomaly that stops time within a designated zone, it appeared to be centered around the town itself.

A group of individuals, including two anomalous figures in black cloaks and several other anomalies, appeared to be immune to its effects. They met with Evan Glass at the clocktower.

When the group attempted to enter the tower, two of the anomalous individuals experienced visions of the others. The girl reported an experience involving the expansion and industrialization of the town. The young man's experience remains unknown. He is to be watched closely. His anomalous readings appear to be vastly higher than those of the rest of the group.

After a brief stop at the guard station, the group managed to outline the boundaries of the Sandwalker zone and supplied themselves with dynamite.

They then returned to the clocktower and destroyed it.

However, this had an unintended consequence.

The tower fell after midnight.

According to the reports, the ground beneath it split open, revealing an underground castle stretching down farther than the eye could see.

From the depths of the castle emerged a figure, levitating above the ground. The figure mocked the group before killing Evan Glass with a crossbow.

We have no information regarding the identity of this killer. The only thing we know for certain is that he retreated back into the castle.

My current theory is that he is somehow connected to the old **Hemmeth monarchy**.

The Black Cloak Order has since taken control of the city, establishing a perimeter around the Sandwalker zone.

But I believe this goes deeper than Marigold and Glass.

It is clear that this is some form of revenge plan. I fear that the perpetrators may intend to collect on the blood debt owed by the entirety of the old council.

If that is the case, this could provide the opening Hemmeth's patron has been waiting for.

I advise sending our own men, my lord.

end report

title: The Chariot
text:
Document by Jack Lemon, based on the report of anomaly Alice

I suppose I should start with their descent into the depths.

The **underground castle** is far more active than we anticipated.

The Black Cloak Order has effectively militarized the surrounding farmland of Eagle's Hope, transforming it into a network of checkpoints and barracks. Anomaly Alice was stationed at a nearby windmill alongside several other entities, including an operative named Maxeridius and the medical anomaly, Dr. Thalia.

Following a briefing by the Black Cloak Captain, the group was ordered to scout the subterranean castle structure, retrieve an artifact if possible, and avoid unnecessary engagement with hostile forces.

Their investigation immediately yielded critical infrastructure data. The castle depths house a transit network designated as the **Chariot Trains**. This system features two distinct operations: a **Black Line** and a **White Line**, both notably distinguished by **sphinxes painted onto the front carriages**. Furthermore, the train system is heavily branded with a **maze symbol**, strongly suggesting this infrastructure was built by the **ancient architect, Norex Volcron**.

The system utilizes highly aggressive, automated toll-collecting constructs. Anomaly Alice managed to bypass immediate termination by purchasing day-long transit tickets using silver currency.

During transit, a localized disturbance occurred when a refreshment construct malfunctioned. The entity known as Maxeridius violently destroyed the machine, triggering the deployment of a masked "enforcer" armed with a high-impact, kinetic wand. Maxeridius sustained a piercing wound to the shoulder but successfully neutralized the enforcer by throwing him from the moving vessel.

The Chariot Train eventually arrived at an organic terminus designated as **Marrow Station**.

The environment at this stop is highly anomalous, consisting entirely of breathing, localized biomass and walls of living flesh. Based on Alice's report, I must note a deeply concerning correlation: the station shares its designation with **Arthur Marrow**, a known **Priest of Flesh and Body operating out of Crescent Hills**. This is highly unlikely to be a coincidence.

Deep within the hemorrhaging corridors of Marrow Station, the group recovered a biological artifact. The object is a **living harp constructed from human anatomy**, possessing a face, arms, and functional fingers bound to the floor by loose teeth. The entity identifies itself as **Tyler**, a former court musician who claims he was horribly transformed by the aforementioned Dr. Arthur Marrow after seeking medical aid for a broken hand.

The extraction of the biological harp triggered an immediate defensive response from the environment. The fleshy structure manifested eyes and a vocal auditory projection demanding the "concert" continue. Concurrently, the group was ambushed by a **featherless, hooked, avian-humanoid construct with skin wings**. Alice utilized destructive magical capabilities—specifically *Hellish Rebuke* and *Eldritch Blast*—to cover their retreat back to the Chariot Train.

Of vital note for our internal surveillance: during the extraction debate, the anomaly known as **JK** revealed he possesses the ability to perceive Alice's invisible companion, Hather. Hather herself has flagged JK as possessing a highly disturbing, anomalous aura possibly linked to local cultist cells. JK was wounded by the avian construct during the escape but remains embedded with the group. He must be monitored.

The group successfully extracted Tyler the Harp back to the surface using climbing pitons and ropes. The Black Cloak Captain was visibly shaken by the specimen but has since remanded Tyler into the custody of Dr. Thalia with strict orders to reverse the biological manipulation.

The connection between Norex Volcron's transit lines, the flesh architecture of Marrow Station, and a Priest of Flesh from Crescent Hills indicates a massive, multi-layered convergence under Eagle's Hope.

I advise we cross-reference our files on the Hemmeth monarchy with the architecture of Norex Volcron immediately, my lord.

end report
